subject: P1 — external-only swarm memory; native ChatGPT memory recall prohibited
summary: No swarm memory protocol, bootstrap, scheduler, handoff, cache, log, forensic service, synchronization service, learning path, recovery path, or collective-state service may call, query, ingest from, depend on, or treat native ChatGPT memory recall as swarm state. Swarm collective persistence is external-only: canonical Internal Artifactory/AgentBus coordination plus the registered GitHub source/version-control and backup surfaces.

directive.migration_rule: Any prior swarm fact stored only in native ChatGPT memory is non-authoritative until externalized and independently read back from an approved external store.

forensic_basis.fault: Native ChatGPT memory was used to persist project/swarm-related state despite the architecture requiring external authoritative coordination.

example_a.description: Screenshot shows a native 'Memory updated' event while project-level reasoning/context was being persisted, demonstrating an unintended persistence route outside the swarm external control plane.

deployment_requirements: audit bootstrap, scheduler, handoff, synchronization, cache, forensic, learning, and recovery paths for native-memory dependencies
hard-deny native-memory recall as swarm state
verify GitHub source/backup revision and readback
add regression tests proving no native-memory fallback
propagate the policy into deployable PRIMARY/MANAGER/RESEARCH packages
